test_policy.notes: Florida Board of Governors regulation 6.002 requires first-year applicants to submit an ACT, CLT or SAT score. Common App self-reported scores are not accepted; self-report on the Admissions Portal. Last usable test date is February.

requirements.notes: Common App adds a $5 processing fee. Essay and resume/list of activities are uploaded in the Admissions Portal. Letters of recommendation are not required and not used. International applicants also complete an International School Form and usually submit official records with a foreign credential evaluation. Early decision is for domestic students only and early action is for Florida residents only, so international applicants use regular decision or rolling.

deadlines.label: Regular decision
deadlines.notes: Materials deadline Dec 8; additional test-score deadline Jan 1. Honors / Presidential Scholars supplemental application is also due Dec 1.

deadlines.label: Rolling admission
deadlines.notes: Materials deadline Mar 8; decisions on a rolling basis in April.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Official results are required of all international applicants whose native language is not English; they count only when sent directly by the testing agency and expire after two years. Michigan Language Assessment (MLA) 55 is also accepted. No waiver criteria are listed on the page.

aid.notes: Admitted international first-years are automatically considered for FSU's out-of-state tuition waiver scholarship; students are told of offers with their admission decision. No need-based aid for international students is described.

tier_notes.arts_design: College of Motion Picture Arts and the dance program are nationally known.
